title: Reflexive Descent to Minimal Seeds: Uniform Bounds and Free Sums: manuscript, code and formal verification
description:
Research revision by Deep Bhattacharjee. The earlier joint manuscript with Ushashi Bhattacharya is credited in a footnote and references.

This version adds a proof of the reflexive-subpolytope order isomorphism for free sums in direct-sum lattices, shortest and longest depth addition, explicit families and a scoped Lean supplement. It contains 81 named source theorems, an axiom audit of 255 declarations including generated auxiliaries, and kernel checks of a stored 5592-node graph with both shortest root lengths 22. A corrupted certificate is rejected.

The full manuscript is not formalized. The graph check does not establish geometric cover completeness. The KS census and twelve interval geometries are not verified end to end in Lean. The exact D4 remains unproved; 22 <= D4 <= 346 is stated relative to the supplied census, and 348 remains the arbitrary-descent bound.

Code is MIT, the manuscript is CC BY 4.0, and coordinate-derived data retain their stated CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution. This release makes no journal acceptance or complete-conjecture-closure claim.
